title: embedding 存储估算器：不同维度的确定性字节数
expected_output:
维度对比 (文档数=1000000, float32):
dim=384  向量=1536.0 MB  索引=8.0 MB  合计=1544.0 MB
dim=768  向量=3072.0 MB  索引=8.0 MB  合计=3080.0 MB
dim=1536  向量=6144.0 MB  索引=8.0 MB  合计=6152.0 MB
code:
def estimate(doc_count, dim, dtype_bytes, index_overhead_per_doc=8):
    vec_bytes = doc_count * dim * dtype_bytes
    idx_bytes = doc_count * index_overhead_per_doc
    return vec_bytes, idx_bytes, vec_bytes + idx_bytes

print('维度对比 (文档数=1000000, float32):')
for dim in (384, 768, 1536):
    vb, ib, tot = estimate(1000000, dim, 4)
    print('dim=%d  向量=%.1f MB  索引=%.1f MB  合计=%.1f MB' % (
        dim, vb / 1e6, ib / 1e6, tot / 1e6))
